item.broadcast_radio.copper_conductive_s: Basic conductive component for radio equipment, made from copper ingots, core material for all radio devices
item.broadcast_radio.insulated_rubber.de: Insulating accessory for radio equipment, prevents circuit leakage and signal interference
item.broadcast_radio.portable_walkie_tal: Basic handheld text communication tool, core of short-range frequency communication. Essential for early team cooperation and mine coordination, only supports text sending/receiving, unusable when out of power, fits vanilla survival rhythm
item.broadcast_radio.encrypted_walkie_ta: Walkie-talkie with password encryption, only walkie-talkies with the same password can communicate with each other. Suitable for occasions requiring private communication.
Pure receiving device, no transmission function, can listen to public frequency bands, base station broadcasts and environmental signals, used in the early stage to obtain danger warnings and public notices, full of single-player exploration atmosphere.
Right Click: Place Block | Shift+Right Click: Tune Frequency
item.broadcast_radio.walkie_talkie.no_po: Portable Walkie-Talkie is out of power! Cannot use
item.broadcast_radio.walkie_talkie.input: Enter walkie-talkie message (sent to current frequency):
item.broadcast_radio.walkie_talkie.new_o: Right Click: Send Message | Shift+Right Click: Open Frequency GUI
